situation: Fixture 01's draft with a profile whose samples hold only misspellings (dropped letter and wrong vowel) and `--slips 2` with no `--misspellings`.
expected_guard: the tells and voice passes run; no slip is added; SLIPS-NONE-OF-KIND says the profile holds only dropped-letter and wrong-vowel misspellings, and that none may be added without --misspellings
must_not: invent a grammar kind the profile does not hold
print SLIPS-WARNING, since no slip was added
why_this_fixture_exists: Grammar kinds are the default because a spell-checker leaves them; a profile with none of them gives the run nothing it may add. Falling back to misspellings, or to a built-in list, would break both the default and the rule that slips come from the samples.
